caption: The image shows a ceramic teapot with an ornate design, photographed in grayscale. The teapot features a prominent, curved handle on the left and a spout shaped like an animal’s head on the right. The body of the teapot is elaborately decorated with a landscape scene that includes trees, a small building, and a figure in a boat. The lid of the teapot matches the decorative motifs seen on the body and is topped with a small finial. Detailed floral patterns and embellishments surround the spout, handle, body, and lid, creating an overall textured and decorative appearance. The teapot sits on a flat surface and the background is plain and light-colored.
title: Teapot - "Wadsworth Tower"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
